import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

print("=== R1: Immutability ===")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
for attr in ['major', 'minor', 'patch', 'prerelease', 'build']:
    try:
        setattr(v, attr, 99)
        print(f"  {attr}: FAIL - no error raised")
    except AttributeError:
        print(f"  {attr}: PASS - AttributeError raised")

print("\n=== R2: Iteration ===")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build1')
values = list(v)
print(f"  Values: {values}")
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build1']
print(f"  Match expected: {values == expected}")

print("\n=== R3: Comparison with tuples vs strings/integers ===")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f"  v == (1,2,3): {v == (1,2,3)}")
print(f"  v < (1,2,4): {v < (1,2,4)}")
try:
    v == "1.2.3"
    print("  v == 'string': FAIL - no error")
except TypeError:
    print("  v == 'string': PASS - TypeError raised")
try:
    v == 42
    print("  v == 42: FAIL - no error")
except TypeError:
    print("  v == 42: PASS - TypeError raised")

print("\n=== R4: Bump methods ===")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f"  bump_major: {v.bump_major()}")
print(f"  bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}")
print(f"  bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}")
v2 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha')
print(f"  bump_prerelease: {v2.bump_prerelease()}")
v3 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f"  bump_build: {v3.bump_build()}")

print("\n=== R5: Type conversion ===")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, prerelease="alpha", build="build1")
print(f"  major type: {type(v.major).__name__}")
print(f"  minor type: {type(v.minor).__name__}")
print(f"  patch type: {type(v.patch).__name__}")
print(f"  prerelease type: {type(v.prerelease).__name__}")
print(f"  build type: {type(v.build).__name__}")

# Test with integer prerelease/build
v2 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, prerelease=123, build=456)
print(f"  prerelease=123 -> '{v2.prerelease}' (type: {type(v2.prerelease).__name__})")
print(f"  build=456 -> '{v2.build}' (type: {type(v2.build).__name__})")
